description: This Java class 'SimpleMapProcessor' is part of the 'minilang' package in the 'ofbiz' framework. It manages processing of simple map-based configurations via XML files, including loading, caching, and executing map processors defined in external XML resources.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: A utility class for managing and executing simple map processors defined in external XML files, with caching and resource resolution.

methods.name: getAllProcessors
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML document from a URL to retrieve all 'simple-map-processor' elements and create corresponding MapProcessor instances.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves map processors from cache or loads them from an XML resource or URL, given resource identifiers.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named map processor from an XML resource or URL, passing input, results, messages, locale, and class loader.
